feature_title: Navbar Group Flyout Dismisses Open Dropdowns

rationale.edition: Both changed paths live under web/src/lib/core/Navbar/ in the open-source frontend tree; no enterprise-owned paths (o2_enterprise/, enterprise/) and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR) appear in the file list or in the changed symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: No explicit opt-out is present: the trigger comment and feature hint are both empty and no tests-added label was passed. The diff modifies a user-facing Vue component (ONavGroup.vue), so it is not docs-/CI-/comment-only, and it is not skipped.
rationale.e2e: The change alters a user-facing interaction in web/src — opening a navbar group flyout now dismisses any open dropdown by dispatching an Escape keydown, so a user hovering the rail with a dropdown open sees different behavior; this changed interaction warrants an E2E test.
rationale.area: The change lives in the shared core Navbar library (web/src/lib/core/Navbar), not inside any Logs/Metrics/Traces/Dashboards product view, so it maps to GeneralTests, which already hosts shared/core UI specs such as cipherKeys and logoManagement.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the existing matrix shard for shared/core UI specs; the new navbar flyout spec joins that group.
rationale.existing_tests: The only changed test file is web/src/lib/core/Navbar/ONavGroup.spec.ts, a Vitest unit spec — not a Playwright E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ — so there are no E2E specs in the diff.
